caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate, blue candlestick placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The candlestick has a broad, round base with raised, scalloped segments that extend upward into a vertical, decorative column. The shaft of the candlestick shows several bulges and narrowing points, contributing to its detailed, sculpted appearance. The top section features a rounded, flower-like design with petal-like shapes surrounding the area where a candle would be inserted. The entire candlestick is shaded in various tones of blue, with lighter highlights and deeper blue shadows used to give the object a three-dimensional appearance. The background remains unadorned and neutral, drawing focus to the blue candlestick as the sole object in the composition.
title: Candlestick
